title: Hamza Oza: Building Design Quality Into Software Factories
description:
Join us in November for AI DevCon NYC 2026. Buy your ticket now, with 30% off using Hamza's code HAMZA30:
https://tessl.co/jj4

Agents can ship UI faster than anyone can review it, so design quality has to be built into the software factory itself, not inspected at the end. Hamza Oza, who leads design at Tessl, shows how at AI DevCon New York this November.

What we cover:
– Why you can't inspect quality in at the end of a production line, and what real factories learned
– The four places Tessl catches design defects in Kikimora, its software factory
– Style rules coding agents read before they build anything
– Automating design checks in CI, and agents that sweep the product for drift
– How to get agents to actually follow your design guidance
– How the design role may evolve once agents are doing the making

Build your software factory, one workflow at a time, with Tessl:
https://tessl.co/mgg

🔔 Subscribe for weekly videos on AI-native development

Where does design quality slip in your software factory? Tell us in the comments.
